title: アドバンスト応用化学
subtitle: Advanced Applied Chemistry
teachers:
TOSA Koji
授業科目の学習・教育目標
educationalGoal: In this course, students learn environmental chemistry, energy chemistry, and biochemistry based on all the basic knowledge they have acquired in the Department of Applied Chemistry.
advice:
In this course, professors in the Department of Applied Chemistry will give lectures on advanced topics that have not been covered in previous lectures, focusing on their own specialized fields. These courses are also connected to the specialized seminars and Preparatory Seminar for Design Project III(Applied Chemistry).

1. Environmental Chemistry
2. Energy Chemistry
3. Biochemistry
requiredKnowledge: All the knowledge and skills learned in the Department of Applied Chemistry in the first and second years are used.
